description:
The Simple Glide Quad E-Bike is unlike anything you’ve ever seen on two—or even three—wheels. With four wheels, a powerful 750W motor, and an advanced recumbent riding design, this e-bike redefines stability and comfort. Whether you’re cruising through your neighborhood, exploring trails, or running errands around town, the Simple Glide Quad offers a riding experience that is equal parts relaxing and exhilarating.

Power and Performance

At the heart of this four-wheeled innovation is a 750W rear-mounted motor, fueled by a 15Ah battery (20Ah upgrade available). With this setup, you’ll enjoy a range of up to 50 miles per charge, depending on terrain, rider weight, and how much you engage the electric assist. Riders can reach 20 mph using throttle-only mode, or push speeds up to 26 mph in pedal assist. Five levels of pedal assist allow you to customize your effort, while the thumb throttle makes it easy to ride without pedaling at all.

Four Wheels for Unmatched Stability

Unlike traditional bikes and even trikes, the Quad design provides maximum balance and control. The dual 20” x 3” rear tires and dual 16” x 3” front tires make this e-bike equally at home on smooth pavement and uneven trails. The unique tilting front steering system keeps both front wheels in constant contact with the ground—when one wheel goes up, the other stays down. The result is smoother, safer turns and the most stable e-bike ride on the market—far beyond what any three-wheeler can offer.

Superior Comfort and Adjustability

The seat is a standout feature, designed for all-day comfort and accessibility. It slides forward and backward, raises and lowers, and even swivels, making mounting and dismounting effortless. Riders will also appreciate the armrests, headrest, and seat belt, which combine to create a secure, ergonomic riding position. This is comfort engineering at its best—ideal for seniors, mobility-focused riders, or anyone who values relaxed cruising.

Safety You Can Trust

The Quad E-Bike is equipped with four hydraulic disc brakes, delivering confident stopping power no matter the terrain. Integrated headlights, taillights, and brake lights ensure visibility. This is not just an e-bike; it’s a safe, dependable mobility solution.

Practical Features for Everyday Use

The Simple Glide Quad is built with utility in mind. Front and rear baskets provide generous cargo space, perfect for groceries, gear, or personal items. An optional canopy shields you from sun or rain, turning your ride into a true all-weather experience.

Why Choose the Simple Glide Quad E-Bike?

Most stable e-bike available – Four wheels with tilting steering for superior balance.

Powerful and versatile – 750W motor, 20–26 mph speeds, and 50-mile range.

Unmatched comfort – Fully adjustable seat with armrests, headrest, and seat belt.

Everyday ready – Cargo baskets, lights, horn, and optional canopy.

The 4 Wheel Simple Glide Quad E-Bike isn’t just transportation—it’s freedom, stability, and comfort on wheels. Once you try it, you’ll wonder how you ever rode anything else.
